_rule: Before any model run, every eval task is run with Harbor's oracle agent. If an oracle trial does not reach reward 1 for an infrastructure reason (image build failure, emulation crash, missing asset, unreachable website), the task is replaced by the first unused reserve task of the same family (families.<family>.reserve in task_subset.json, in rank order) and logged below. The subset is frozen once the first model run starts; no amendments after that.
